items.title: Embecta shares jump as Owen Mumford acquisition lifts quarterly revenue
items.summary: Embecta, which bought UK device maker Owen Mumford this year, reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $298.7m, up 13.1%, with Owen Mumford contributing $27.6m.

items.title: Leicester researchers respond to government call for insights into global health picture
items.summary: Healthcare researchers in Leicester have highlighted the impact of overseas aid after contributing to a government inquiry into the current global health funding situation.

items.title: Newly identified glucose uptake pathway could pave the way for new diabetes treatments
items.summary: Researchers in the US have identified a previously unknown mechanism that enables skeletal muscles to absorb glucose from the bloodstream independently of insulin, potentially paving the way for new treatments for diabetes and insulin resistance.

items.title: Obesity & Weight Management Alliance call for poster abstracts submissions
items.summary: The Obesity & Weight Management Alliance anticipate that they will receive sponsorship from pharmaceutical companies and MedTech organisations for the 2027 conferences. As soon as sponsorship is confirmed, the details will be added to the website and all promotional materials where appropriate.

items.title: Type 1 diabetes research centre at University of Oxford marks its first year
items.summary: A research centre at the University of Oxford dedicated to advancing the prevention, treatment and management of type 1 diabetes is celebrating its first anniversary.

items.title: World’s first multidisciplinary diabetic foot clinic renamed in honour of founder
items.summary: A pioneering diabetic foot clinic that has helped thousands of people avoid limb amputation has been renamed in honour of the consultant diabetologist who founded the service 45 years ago.

items.title: Research highlights long-term health risks of gestational diabetes
items.summary: Women with a history of gestational diabetes are up to 10 times more likely to develop type 2 diabetes, with the health implications of the condition potentially extending to their children, a new review has highlighted.

items.title: Participants sought for study exploring emotional wellbeing in people with diabetes
items.summary: Adults living with type 1 or type 2 diabetes are being invited to take part in a doctoral research study exploring how digital interventions can support emotional wellbeing.

items.title: Medtronic diabetes spin-off weighs on annual revenue guidance
items.summary: MassDevice reports that the separation of Medtronic's diabetes business has weighed on revenue guidance; cardiovascular grew 10% with electrophysiology sales up 18%.

items.title: Insulet names Todd Trapp as chief financial officer
items.summary: Insulet has appointed Todd Trapp to succeed Flavia Pease as chief financial officer from 7 December.

items.title: North Manchester General Hospital wins national award
items.summary: North Manchester General Hospital, part of Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust, has been named the winner of the Hypo Awareness Week Excellence Award in recognition of its outstanding contribution to this year’s national campaign.

items.title: Glucose sensors for type 2 diabetes deserve second look from NHS, Manchester researchers say
items.summary: A wearable sensor that allows people with type 2 diabetes using insulin to track their glucose levels in real time could prove good value for the NHS, a University of Manchester led study suggests.

items.title: Afternoon webinar to share UK best practice in diabetes care findings
items.summary: Spirit Health is bringing their UK delegates together for an informal Teams session to share the highlights, key learnings and ideas from their recent Diabetes Exchange visit to South Korea.

items.title: MiniMed targets competition with upcoming diabetes devices
items.summary: MiniMed's CEO says the company wants to give people a reason to switch, with the launch of its first insulin patch pump (MedTech Dive).

items.title: Glasgow diabetes team wins Rowan Hillson Inpatient Diabetes Award 2026
items.summary: A diabetes team from NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde has won the Rowan Hillson Inpatient Diabetes Award 2026 for developing a checklist designed to improve patient safety and standardise inpatient diabetes care.

items.title: Senseonics and Beta Bionics launch integrated diabetes management technology
items.summary: Senseonics and Beta Bionics have launched an integrated diabetes technology and committed to integrating Senseonics' full-year CGM with Beta Bionics' tubeless patch pump in future. Article page is bot-blocked; date taken from the newsletter.

items.title: FDA clears MiniMed Fit tubeless insulin pump
items.summary: MiniMed has received US FDA clearance for MiniMed Fit, a tubeless insulin pump. US regulatory clearance only; no UK availability stated. Relevant as a product move by a major insulin pump supplier.

items.title: MiniMed launches its smallest automated insulin delivery system in Europe
items.summary: MiniMed has begun commercial shipments of its new MiniMed Flex system across Europe, marking the launch of the company’s first app-controlled insulin pump and its smallest automated insulin delivery (AID) system to date.

items.title: Call for participants to respond to international research survey to shape improvements to diabetes inpatient care and education
items.summary: The International Diabetes Federation (IDF) Hospital Diabetes Taskforce is conducting an international research survey to understand current practices, systems, and models of care for the management of diabetes and hyperglycemia among hospitalised adults.

items.title: Tandem wins FDA clearance for tubeless Mobi automated insulin delivery
items.summary: FDA cleared a new infusion set and cartridge that lets Tandem's Mobi pump be worn tubeless (on-body kit, up to seven days' wear). Tandem plans a 2027 US launch, putting it head to head with MiniMed's new Fit patch pump in the tubeless insulin market.

items.title: embecta reduces Viva™ insulin pen needle pricing to £2 per box across all needle lengths
items.summary: Through the NHS Drug Tariff Review process, embecta has agreed a reduction in the price of its Viva™ insulin pen needles, with all needle lengths soon to be available to the NHS at just £2.00 per box. embecta Micro-Fine™ insulin pen needles have also been accepted for a price reduction to £2.90 per box.

items.title: Spirit Health Foundation launches free digital diabetes care programme to tackle digital exclusion
items.summary: Spirit Health Foundation’s new charitable initiative will help vulnerable people in care and underserved communities access continuous glucose monitoring through free smartphones, training and ongoing support. Almost six million people in the UK live with diabetes.

items.title: Nurses urged to ‘think type 1’ this World Diabetes Day
items.summary: To mark World Diabetes Day, Diabetes UK’s Katie Bareford urges nurses and healthcare professionals to ‘think type 1’ and test immediately when children present with any of the 4Ts, as rates of life-threatening diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) at diagnosis reach an eight-year high.

items.title: WHO urges healthcare professionals to prioritise early diagnosis and equitable care this World Diabetes Day
items.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) is calling on healthcare professionals to strengthen early diabetes detection, improve access to quality treatment and tackle stigma as part of its World Diabetes Day 2026 campaign.

items.title: Weight-loss surgery linked to long-term type 2 diabetes remission, 14-year study finds
items.summary: People with type 2 diabetes who undergo weight-loss surgery are significantly more likely to achieve remission than those receiving medication and lifestyle treatment alone, according to new research published in Diabetes Care.

items.title: Final free quality improvement programme launched to improve care for young adults with type 2 diabetes
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being encouraged to register for a free introductory webinar this November as part of the final phase of a national quality improvement programme aimed at improving outcomes for young adults with type 2 diabetes.

items.title: X-PERT Health joins Spirit Health to strengthen diabetes education across the UK
items.summary: Established provider of structured diabetes education X-PERT Health has joined Spirit Health Group. The move brings X-PERT alongside Spirit’s EMPOWER programme, with both continuing to offer people living with diabetes practical support to manage their health and live well.

items.title: UK delegation learns about Korean diabetes care
items.summary: A team of healthcare professionals from the UK gained a “unique insight” about diabetes care in South Korea as part of Spirit Health’s new knowledge exchange programme.

items.title: Too many children reaching ‘crisis point’ before type 1 diabetes is recognised
items.summary: Hundreds of babies and young children are becoming seriously ill each year before their type 1 diabetes is diagnosed, a leading charity has warned.

items.title: The Kar Report: PDEL, Oh no…more acronyms. Or is it?
items.summary: So, once again, it’s all change in the NHS. Amidst all the acronyms, one cannot miss the return of SHA – previously Strategic Health Authorities – which will undoubtedly raise a smile among those who have lived through previous NHS reorganisations.

items.title: Beano-inspired classroom resources aim to improve type 1 diabetes awareness among children and teachers
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being encouraged to raise awareness of free educational resources designed to improve the understanding of type 1 diabetes (T1D) in primary schools, following a collaboration between Sanofi UK, DigiBete and Beano for Schools.

items.title: New AI-driven device for predicting overnight hypoglycaemia available for first time on NHS for people with diabetes in Devon
items.summary: People living with diabetes across Devon can now access a new AI-powered continuous glucose monitor (CGM) through the NHS for the first time, as a new campaign launches in the region to highlight the impact of the condition on everyday life.

items.title: Free Diabetes UK webinar series to inspire better diabetes care this winter
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being invited to join a free winter webinar series from Diabetes UK, bringing together expert knowledge, real-world experiences and practical ideas to help improve diabetes care and outcomes.

items.title: The Big Interview: Joy Allen on how AI-powered technology is transforming diabetes management
items.summary: Watch now: How can AI-powered technology transform diabetes management and give people greater confidence to live life on their terms? Diabetes Times Editor Oliver Jelley speaks with Joy Allen, Head of Market Access and Public Affairs at Roche Diagnostics, for the latest Big Interview.

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — Tandem Mobi insulin pump with interoperable technology
First UK patient receives teplizumab on NHS to delay type 1 diabetes
items.summary: A woman from Shropshire has become the first patient in the UK to receive teplizumab through routine NHS care, following the approval of the groundbreaking treatment to delay the progression of type 1 diabetes.

items.title: Obesity & Weight Management Alliance expands 2027 conference programme across UK and Ireland
items.summary: The Obesity & Weight Management Alliance anticipate that they will receive sponsorship from pharmaceutical companies and MedTech organisations for the 2027 conferences. As soon as sponsorship is confirmed, the details will be added to the website and all promotional materials where appropriate.

items.title: Free webinar to explore diagnosis and management of diabetic autonomic neuropathy
items.summary: Leading international experts will discuss the diagnosis, screening and treatment of cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy and diabetic gastroenteropathy during a free educational webinar this November.

items.title: Better training in new diabetes tech needed for community nurses
items.summary: Community nurses and other non-specialist staff need more training to provide support to patients with diabetes using modern insulin-management systems, a new report has found.

items.title: GPs ‘should monitor diabetes risk’ in months after starting patients on antipsychotics
items.summary: Significant metabolic changes are seen in the first 90 days of use of antipsychotic medications, say researchers who recommend closer monitoring at the start.

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — Safe AQ Easy Blood Glucose Monitoring System; Safe AQ Care Blood Glucose Monitoring System
Insulin: types, actions and principles of safe administration
items.summary: Understanding insulin action, types and factors influencing insulin use is essential for delivering safe, effective patient-centred care.
